subject.title: Stale client registration replayed to DCR forever; only --reset recovers

question: What provider evidence should qualify a DCR failure as a stale cached-client rejection that may trigger one scoped client invalidation and retry?
rationale: The proposed recovery is likely narrow, but a bare ServerError is not enough to distinguish permanent stale-client rejection from a transient registration outage or a server-configuration identity change.

options.title: Require a current-main provider repro
options.body: Reproduce the project-reference switch against current main and capture the registration response or diagnostics before selecting a narrowly classified retry condition.

options.title: Treat configuration changes as invalidation
options.body: Define a server configuration identity change as sufficient to invalidate persisted client and discovery state before auth, independently of an unstructured DCR error.

options.title: Keep reset-only recovery
options.body: Retain the current manual recovery path until providers expose a safely classifiable stale-client error.

recommendation.title: Require a current-main provider repro
recommendation.body: Reproduce the project-reference switch against current main and capture the registration response or diagnostics before selecting a narrowly classified retry condition.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest merged history for scoped OAuth credential recovery is the OAuth vault recovery change authored by steipete.
